'''Dave Danley''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Green Bay tournament]] on 25 February 2001 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court]], according to Mark Kloida's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1820">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-01-gb-wisconsin-2-25d1820/ gb-wisconsin-2-25], DeckTech (Mark "yodarth" Kloida, 1 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-01-gb-wisconsin-2-25d1820/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
